summary: Select kernel configurations with bounded search and validation rather than overfitting a single favorable timing.
outcomes: Define a legal configuration search space and workload keys.
Build dispatch rules that include correctness, compile cost and fallback.
sequence: List shape and hardware factors that change the best configuration.
Validate before timing with controlled repeated measurements.
Separate training shapes from held-out evaluation shapes.
Cache dispatch decisions and handle unknown cases.

visual.question: Does the fastest tile for this shape remain best nearby?
visual.interaction: Explore shapes and compare measured candidate distributions.

practice.task: Build a small autotuner with held-out shape evaluation.
practice.success: No invalid configuration is selected; runtime benefit includes search/compile amortization and a fallback.
